subject.title: Feature: Opt-in cross-channel visibility in TUI (mirror iMessage/Telegram activity)

question: Should TUI get an opt-in cross-channel observe or mirror mode, and should the first approved surface be read-only observation or bidirectional mirrored delivery?
rationale: The source shows existing session-event plumbing but no public surface; choosing transcript visibility, redaction, retention, session scope, and outbound delivery policy is a product/security decision automation cannot safely make.

options.title: Approve read-only observe MVP
options.body: Add a default-off TUI observe mode that shows only authorized activity for an explicit agent/session scope and does not send mirrored messages back to channels.

options.title: Wait for shared activity contract
options.body: Coordinate this with the broader activity timeline and Telegram activity-visibility work before adding another observer surface.

options.title: Decline core mirroring
options.body: Keep logs, session tailing, and the narrow selected-session live-update fix as the supported path, avoiding a core cross-channel TUI mirror feature.

recommendation.title: Approve read-only observe MVP
recommendation.body: Add a default-off TUI observe mode that shows only authorized activity for an explicit agent/session scope and does not send mirrored messages back to channels.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current routing owner from the cited TUI isolation landing and the active narrow live-update PR context.
